The following events took place in '''22 [[Galactic Standard Calendar|ABY]]'''.

==Events==
*[[Danni Quee]] joined the [[Extragalactic Society]].<ref name="ExGal">According to ''[[The New Jedi Order: Vector Prime]]'', [[Danni Quee]] joined the [[Extragalactic Society]] three [[Standard year/Legends|years]] earlier. Since that book is set in [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]] per ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', Quee joined the ExGal Soeciety in 22 ABY.</ref>
*The [[Solo twins]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] and [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] joined [[Luke Skywalker/Legends|Luke Skywalker's]] [[Jedi Praxeum]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]].<ref name="Solo twins academy">According to [https://web.archive.org/web/20100118183249/http://www.starwars.com/databank/character/jacensolo/index.html Jacen Solo's entry] on the [[StarWars.com]] [[Databank (original)|Databank]], [[Jaina Solo Fel|Jaina Solo]] and [[Gender/Legends|her]] twin brother [[Darth Caedus|Jacen]] were in their early teens when they first joined the [[Jedi Praxeum|Jedi Academy]] on [[Yavin 4/Legends|Yavin 4]]. Since they were already students by ''[[Junior Jedi Knights: The Golden Globe]]'', when they were thirteen [[Standard year/Legends|years]] old, the Solos first started training to be a [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] at age thirteen. The twins were [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] in [[9 ABY/Legends|9 ABY]] according to ''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]'', meaning they turned thirteen in 22 ABY. Since ''The Essential Reader's Companion'' also dates ''The Golden Globe'' to 22 ABY, Jaina and Jacen Solo first came to the Jedi Academy the same year.</ref>
*The youngest [[Solo family/Legends|Solo]] child, [[Anakin Solo|Anakin]], joined the [[Junior Jedi Academy|Junior Jedi Class]] of the [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Praxeum [[Standard month/Legends|months]] later and befriended a young [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|girl]] named [[Tahiri Veila]]. The two young [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|trainees]] had several adventures including discovering the [[Golden Globe]] and the ancient [[Jedi Master/Legends|Jedi Master]] [[Ikrit]],<ref name="Golden Globe">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: The Golden Globe]]''</ref> accompanying their [[Melodie]] friend [[Lyric]] to her homeworld of [[Yavin 8/Legends|Yavin 8]] to undergo an [[Changing Ceremony|important ceremony]],<ref name="Lyric's World">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Lyric's World]]''</ref> visits to [[Dagobah/Legends|Dagobah]] to discover Anakin's future,<ref name="Anakin's Quest">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Anakin's Quest]]''</ref> the [[Mission to Bast Castle|discovery]] of [[Obi-Wan Kenobi/Legends|Obi-Wan Kenobi's]] [[Obi-Wan Kenobi's third lightsaber/Legends|lightsaber]] and the [[Asli Krimsan's holocron|holocron]] of ancient Jedi Master [[Asli Krimsan]] at [[Bast Castle]] on [[Vjun/Legends|Vjun]]<ref name="Vader's Fortress">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Vader's Fortress]]''</ref> and the [[Mission to Exis Station|defeat]] of the fake [[Prophets of the Dark Side|mage]] [[Orloc]].<ref name="Kenobi's Blade">''[[Junior Jedi Knights: Kenobi's Blade]]''</ref><ref name="TERC">''[[The Essential Reader's Companion]]''</ref> Anakin later returned to [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]] where he attended school, developed his [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] skills, and studied under the careful tutelage of [[C-3PO/Legends|C-3PO]].
*Luke and [[Mara Jade Skywalker]] travelled to the [[Unknown Regions/Legends|Unknown Regions]] where they joined a multigalactic effort composed of the New Republic, [[Chiss Ascendancy/Legends|Chiss Ascendancy]] and [[Empire of the Hand]] to locate the remains of the ill-fated [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Old Republic]] expedition [[Outbound Flight Project|''Outbound Flight'']]. They discovered it in an inaccessible region known as [[The Redoubt/Legends|The Redoubt]] and also learned that the survivors of the Outbound Flight had founded a [[Outbound Flight Colony|colony]] within the wreckage. This combined team also defeated a [[Vagaari/Legends|Vagaari]] [[Battle of the Redoubt|attack]].<ref name="SQ">''[[Survivor's Quest]]''</ref><ref name="TERC" />
*[[Lando Calrissian/Legends|Lando Calrissian's]] memoir ''[[How to Succeed in Everything]]'' is published.<ref name="EGF185">[[Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force (real-life book)|''Jedi vs. Sith: The Essential Guide to the Force'']]</ref>
